enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up to chin. Stretch legs. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Pull blanket down. Turn onto back. Place arms at sides. Remain still.
Turn on light. Turn on tap. Splash water on face. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and pan. Close cabinet. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Toast bread in toaster. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat eggs and toast. Drink milk. Rinse dishes. Turn off light.

Put on coat. Pick up bag. Open door. Walk out. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at stop. Get off bus. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Swipe ID card. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurse station. Pick up clipboard. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Record data. Administer medication. Talk to doctor.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at stop. Get off bus. Walk to home. Open door. Enter home. Lock door. Remove coat. Put down bag.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Cook meat. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Rinse dishes. Turn off light.

Enter living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Get up. Go to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Return to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Get up. Turn off TV. Walk to bedroom.
Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light.
Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket.
Lie in bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to other side. Pull blanket up. Relax body.
